verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so background automations are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence documents only interactive per-chat agent work. The full-permissions toggle skips approval prompts during a session, which is an adjacent control, not scheduled or background automation. No evidence shows recurring schedules, triggers, or background task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
